claims.statement: Management expects to get a very clear picture on the Minimax model in another year or two.
claims.quote: I don't know, maybe another year or two, we'll get a very clear picture.

facts.statement: MMR operations have not yet broken even at a PBT level.
Pharmacy spaces within stores take around 600, 800, or sometimes even 300 square feet.
facts.quote: I think pharmacy takes around 600, 800, or sometimes even 300 square feet.

facts.statement: Minimax stores operate on lease rather than being owned.
For ready-built properties, the company does a valuation when the store opens and splits the cost into land and building based on a valuation certificate.
facts.quote: So, in a ready-built property, what we do is we do a valuation of the property when the store opens and then we split the cost based on the valuation certificate into land and building.
